messages:
lina: heads-up — started the BMC firmware batch (v1.2.4 -> v1.2.6) against eu-west GPU racks at 02:00 UTC. a subset of nodes reprovisioning hit repeated pagecache-related OOM-like traces during rootfs remount and then dropped from the pool.

jonathan: saw 3 nodes in eu-west-3 show the same pattern, GPUs stuck in Allocating state. I grabbed the serial logs.

infra-bot: [alert] bmc-update-failure: 3 nodes failed post-flash healthcheck (eu-west-3). Auto-retry disabled.

kai: can you paste the dmesg/serial snippet? might be NIC driver interacting with bmc u-boot handshake.

lina: snippet from one node serial:
```
[    5.432101] Out of memory: Killed process 1234 (reprovision) total-vm:204800kB, anon-rss:102400kB
[    5.432105] kernel: page cache corruption detected at ffff88007b3d4c00
[    5.432110] bmc-fw: postflash: secure_toggle=1 -> unexpected
[    5.432115] rpc: svc: killing connection from jumper-host
```
Not huge, but consistent across the three.

kevin: this isn't the normal flash timeout. pagecache corruption + secure_toggle flip smells like BMC handing a bad thermal/PCI sequence during early handoff. Could be a regression in 1.2.6 bootloader.

ops-lead: immediate ask: hold the rest of the rollout. We can't afford more racks in Allocating. Also flag for SOC/compliance: secure-boot state toggled unexpectedly.

lina: agreed — halting the eu-west rollout now. marking remaining nodes as deferred and setting concurrency=0. Will run a targeted revert on the 3 affected nodes to 1.2.4 as per rollback runbook.

jonathan: for triage — we should run `bmcctl flash verify` + `bmcctl show-config` on affected units and collect NX-serial logs. Also capture NIC firmware versions; similar interactions seen with ixgbe firmware in the past.

kai: I'll script a quick collector and a minimal reproducer to run in the lab. If it's the bootloader handshake, we should be able to reproduce with controlled power cycles.

lina: running revert now. ETA ~18m for first node back online.

infra-bot: deploybot: rollout paused by lina. 12 nodes deferred.

kevin: mitigation proposal: 1) pause all BMC updates until kernel patch + bootloader patch validated in lab, 2) add a pre-flash NV check to detect pagecache anomalies, 3) disable the automatic secure-boot toggling step in the updater.

ops-lead: cost impact calc — three racks (~48 GPUs) out for 30m -> approx $1.8k lost throughput. add to incident cost sheet.

maria: once revert completes, can we reschedule a narrow canary window with single-node concurrency and extended healthchecks (10m)? I'll open a calendar invite and tag security for the secure-boot toggle discussion.

lina: yes. will attach serial logs and the `bmcctl` outputs to the ticket. follow-up after revert and lab repro. :white_check_mark:

jonathan: noted. assigning follow-up to kevin/kai for root cause and PR for the updater.

infra-bot: ticket created: INFRA-7241 — "BMC fw 1.2.6 -> pagecache corruption on eu-west canary".

lina: closing thread for now, will post status when first node is healthy.
